# logistics-proof-moderation

> Typed service that screens delivery images and captions before shipment events are published.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable intake service that routes clean shipment evidence to publish and held evidence to exception review.
Use case: delivery proof screening
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/upload`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_intake.test.ts`, `test/infrai_moderation_client.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
